title: Standard WOFOST threshold and event semantics evidence

events.name: emergence
events.legacy_timing: evaluated in the flDayStart crop-rotation path; WOFOST state is initialized when fl_start_cropemergence becomes true
state_effects: initial biomass and first leaf cohort are created
events.splitting_implication: legacy does not define continuous within-day emergence. A future arbitrary event split must be qualified separately rather than inferred from generic kernel time.

events.name: anthesis_DVS_1
events.legacy_timing: during the once-daily phenology-rate calculation before the daily biomass/state update
events.transition: if DVS+dvr >= 1 and fl_anthesis is false, set fl_anthesis=true and truncate dvr to exactly 1-DVS
events.scientific_note: the day's assimilation and most growth rates still use the pre-update crop state; the threshold is not resolved by subdaily event splitting in B1.10
events.splitting_implication: splitting the day at the exact anthesis crossing would change rate evaluation order and is not automatically equivalent.

events.name: vernalization_completion_or_forcing
events.legacy_timing: evaluated on the daily phenology event; fl_vernalised can become true when critical DVS is reached or after post-update vern accumulation reaches VERNSAT
events.special_hold: vernrate SAVE carryover after fl_vernalised requires separate semantic reconciliation before IDSL=2 can be fully admitted
events.splitting_implication: subdaily splitting could alter the day on which vernalization reduction ceases and therefore requires scientific qualification.

events.name: leaf_cohort_creation_and_ageing
events.legacy_timing: exactly once per WOFOST update call under delt=1
transition: leaf death is applied to existing cohorts
all retained cohorts are shifted one class
physiological age is incremented by fysdel*delt
one new cohort is inserted at index 1 with LV=grlv*delt, SLA=slat, LVAGE=0
cohort count increments by one before reconstructing WLV/LASUM
events.splitting_implication: calling the same logic twice in a day creates two cohorts and performs two shifts. Arbitrary interval splitting is therefore not scientifically or numerically neutral.

events.name: root_depth_and_distribution_change
events.legacy_timing: after wofost(3) at day end, root extension and root distribution are updated once from the day's crop rates and accepted daily stress/uptake aggregates
events.state_optionality: SWRD=2 and SWRDC=1 have irreducible history state; SWRD=1/SWRD=3 and nonadaptive distribution can derive current geometry from committed crop state plus immutable parameters
events.splitting_implication: multiple updates within the same crop window can change stress-limited extension and adaptive distribution history.

events.name: maturity_or_crop_end
events.legacy_timing: after the daily growth update, cropdevelopment(4) checks DVS>=DVSEND or the configured crop-end date and then deactivates/harvests the crop
events.splitting_implication: B1.10 maturity is a day-end event. An exact within-day DVSEND crossing is not an admitted boundary in the legacy oracle.

event_splitting_policy.reason: phenology thresholds, climate memory, cohort operations and root updates are call-order/cadence sensitive
event_splitting_policy.future_requirement: qualify each split/merge transformation against the one-day reference oracle before changing process cadence
